items.label: Domain
items.description: The address people use to reach this application.
items.long_description: Used for the links in emails, such as invitations and password resets. Enter a host name like app.example.com, or a full address like https://app.example.com. Leave it empty to use the server's own address, which is usually localhost. Organizations can override it with their own domain.

items.label: Login headline
items.description: The large heading beside the sign-in form. Leave blank for "Welcome back".
items.long_description: Shown on the login page next to the form. An organization can set its own.

items.label: Login subtitle
items.description: The line under the login headline. Leave blank for "Sign in to pick up where you left off."
items.long_description: Shown on the login page under the headline. An organization can set its own.
